cache_enabled.label: Enable audio file cache
cache_enabled.description: Download complete audio files with yt-dlp and reuse them for subsequent playback.

cache_dir.label: Audio cache directory
cache_dir.description: Writable directory on the Music Assistant server. Each provider instance stores its files in a separate subdirectory. Container installations require a mounted writable directory.

cache_max_size_mb.label: Maximum audio cache size (MB)
cache_max_size_mb.description: Maximum retained audio size per provider instance in MiB (default: 1024). Set 0 for unlimited storage. Least recently used files are removed first; larger files are streamed without caching. Temporary downloads and metadata are not included.

manifest.description: Browse public YouTube Music metadata and play audio through yt-dlp with a configurable file cache.
